meaning: A fault or weakness that makes something less perfect

meaning: A problem or difficulty you must deal with to succeed

meaning: A particular quality in a person's character

meaning: Your general attitude or way of thinking about life

meaning: To accept something unpleasant without complaining or stopping it

meaning: To follow a rule, order or request

meaning: The events that will happen to a person in the future, as if planned

meaning: The reason why someone does something

meaning: A hidden danger or mistake that is easy to fall into

meaning: An idea or statement you accept as true as a starting point

meaning: A situation where there is not enough of something

meaning: The point at which something begins or changes

meaning: The ability to guess and prepare for what may happen

meaning: Something you must do because of a duty, law or promise

meaning: To make sure people obey a rule or law

meaning: Large, heavy or slow, and difficult to handle or use

meaning: A typical model or pattern of how something is done or thought

meaning: The freedom or good judgement to decide what to do or say

meaning: Kindness in punishing or judging, being less strict than expected

meaning: The quality of being allowed by law or accepted as right

meaning: A special right that belongs to one person or group

meaning: To explain something clearly so it is easy to understand

meaning: To reduce or cut short something

meaning: To make something larger or greater by adding to it

meaning: To give up something such as power or a right

meaning: To make a bad situation or belief continue

meaning: To go beyond the usual limits of something

meaning: To force someone to do something by using threats

meaning: To prove that a statement or idea is wrong

meaning: To slow down or block the progress of something

meaning: To cause something bad to start, such as a fight

meaning: To put something in danger of being lost or harmed

meaning: To place two different things together to show the contrast

meaning: To cancel the effect of something or make it useless
